description: Secrets leak detector: finds API keys, tokens, private keys, seed phrases, JWTs and connection strings (AWS, GitHub, OpenAI, Anthropic, Stripe, Slack, Google and 30+ more) in text or a URL; masked findings with line numbers, optional redacted copy. Use before logging, committing, pasting, summarising or sending text that might hold credentials: configs, .env files, logs, diffs, tool output. Pass text or url. Returns found, count, severity (high, medium, low or none), findings[] {type e.g. aws-access-key-id or github-token, provider, severity, confidence, masked, line, column}, byProvider counts, summary and, with redact: true, the same text with each secret replaced by [REDACTED:type]. Nothing is stored. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails. Includes free daily calls, no wallet needed.

redact.description: Also return `redacted`: the text with every secret replaced by [REDACTED:type] (default false)

text.description: Text to scan: a config, log, diff, prompt, document or tool output (up to 2,000,000 characters)

url.description: Public URL to fetch and scan instead of text

name: scan_secrets

masked.description: First and last characters kept, the middle masked

type.description: e.g. aws-access-key-id, github-token, openai-api-key, private-key, bip39-seed-phrase, database-url, generic-api-key

redacted.description: The input with every secret replaced by [REDACTED:type]; only with redact: true

url.description: Present when a url was fetched

title: Secrets leak detector
